Subject: Apex Supply: onboarding docs for PO setup (COI, W9, bank details)

Hi Jordan / Accounts team,

Thanks for agreeing to get set up with us. To complete vendor onboarding and create the PO on our side we need the following items:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) naming Redwood Inference as additionally insured and Waiver of Subrogation where applicable
- Completed W9 (if US entity) or tax form equivalent
- Bank account details for ACH (bank name, account last 4, routing number) — we will request a voided check for verification
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) so we can map billing codes and tax IDs

I have attached our redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx to capture the fields Finance needs. Please send the COI and W9 as PDF attachments and fill out the bank_info_redwood_form.xlsx. If you prefer, you can also upload securely to the Drive link below.

Goal is to have the PO in place by end of week so we can start processing invoices.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx

Thanks,
Olga Petrov

- PO created: PO-98765 (see attached PO-98765.pdf)
- Scheduled vendor record creation in our AP system; tax profile set to "US - W9 on file"
